source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of control structures (PDF 41).

blocks.text: Programs ko aksar sharait ke mutabiq faisla karna ya kaam kai baar dohrana hota hai. Control structures yeh karte hain, aur in ki do bari qismein hain: decision making aur looping.

blocks.alt: Baen: flowchart jo jaanchta hai ke mausam dhoop wala hai, phir barish wala, aur sunglasses pehnne, chhatri lene ya din enjoy karne tak jata hai, if, if-else, short-hand if-else, if-elif-else aur nesting ke notes ke saath. Daen: flowchart jo number ko 1 rakhta aur jab tak number 10 se kam ho use print kar ke 1 jorta hai, while, for aur range() ke notes ke saath.
blocks.caption: Decision making aur loops (topic 2.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: if-elif-else ki zanjeer sharait ko tarteeb se jaanchti aur pehli sach shart ka block chalati hai: agar mausam dhoop wala ho to program kehta hai sunglasses pehnein, warna agar barish ho to chhatri lein, warna din enjoy karein. while loop har chakkar se pehle shart jaanchta hai: number 1 se shuru ho kar jab tak 10 se kam ho use print kar ke 1 jorta hai, to 1 se 9 tak print kar ke shart jhoot hone par ruk jata hai. for loop sequence ki har cheez baari baari leta hai, aur range() adad ki sequences banata hai jaise 0 se 4.

blocks.prompt: Control structures ki do bari qismein bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Decision making (if, if-else, if-elif-else) aur looping (while aur for loops).

items: Control structures: decision making (shart se amal chunna) aur looping (amal dohrana).
